name: multi-agent-folder-cleanup
description: Keep shared project folders usable by many AI agents: Work mode for saving, naming, indexing, session logs and handoff; Audit, Plan and Execute modes to inspect and safely reorganize folders or portfolios with verified execution boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Keep shared project folders usable by many agents
interface.longDescription: Work mode: where to save, how to name, one authoritative tracker and index, session logging and handoff, plus read-only orient, session-index and pending checks. Cleanup modes: find conflicting authority, cross-project search contamination, stale indexes, missing entrypoints, documentary-only claims, duplicate or pointer records, generated noise and unsafe move or connector-edit conditions; plan or execute only an explicitly approved mutation list and verify the result.
capabilities: Work mode: save, name, index, log and hand off in shared folders
Verified move, record-only, and additive-intake checks
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $multi-agent-folder-cleanup for this shared project folder: pick the mode (Work for ordinary saving, logging and handoff; Audit, Plan or Execute for questions about the folder or reorganizing it) and state it first.
